[EN] Repo Work
[ES] Trabajo de embargo
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Without those shards, this place would die.
[ES] Sin esos fragmentos, este lugar moriría.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You've saved us.
[ES] Nos has salvado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Recover the stolen shard packs.
[ES] Recupera los paquetes de fragmentos robados.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Dena at Bleakrock.
[ES] Habla con Dena en Bleakrock.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Shard Packs
[ES] Paquetes de fragmentos
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The federation is finished in Frost Reach!
[ES] ¡La federación está acabada en Frost Reach!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Blast and damnation!
[ES] ¡Maldición y pestes!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] These shards belong to the Junaidar!
[ES] ¡Estos fragmentos pertenecen a los Junaidar!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Those shards are mine!
[ES] ¡Esos fragmentos son míos!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take the shards, if you can!
[ES] ¡Toma los fragmentos, si puedes!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] So...cold.
[ES] Qué... frío.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Slay the Junaidar forces along Ice Trail and recover the shard packs.
[ES] Mata a las fuerzas Junaidar a lo largo de Ice Trail y recupera los paquetes de fragmentos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return the shard packs to Dena in Bleakrock.
[ES] Devuelve los paquetes de fragmentos a Dena en Bleakrock.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
[ES] "¡Por la federación!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
